name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Mabel's weight is between the angler who landed the Trout and the angler at Grayreach.
The angler fishing with Shrimp's weight is immediately below Dale.
Royce's weight is immediately below the angler fishing with Leech.
Dale's weight is at least 3 lb more than the angler who landed the Pike.
The angler at Mossbank's weight is at most 1 lb away from the angler who landed the Carp.
The angler who landed the Bass' weight is higher than both Mabel and the angler fishing with Nightcrawler.
Everyone in the East Watershed ranks higher in weight than everyone in the South Watershed.
